args.subject: Refund Confirmation for Incorrect Shipment (Ticket C-4463)
args.body:
Dear Adatum Ltd,

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the hardware being shipped to the wrong location (Leeds DC instead of your intended site).

As a gesture of goodwill, we have processed and issued a **£175 refund** to your account. The refund should reflect in your records within **2–5 business days** via the original payment method. If you have not received it by then, please contact us directly at **support@adatum.ltd** or reference this ticket.

We regret any disruption this may have caused and appreciate your patience. Should you require further assistance—such as reshipping the hardware or clarifying the refund status—do not hesitate to reach out.

Best regards,
The IT-Ops Support Team
